citations.claim: first violation: pole angle -0.81 rad exceeds 0.8 limit
one step before violation, angle -0.698 rad still within but rapidly diverging with high angular velocity
earlier divergence phase showing pole angle -0.486 rad and controller force increasing

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.00811 to 0.0 (single field change) - removes measurement noise that destabilizes the state-feedback controller, allowing it to balance pole within limits

explanation: Shrunk scenario fails pole_upright at step 17 (theta -0.81 rad, limit 0.8) with no external pushes. Sensor noise 0.008 causes controller to mis-estimate angle (initial theta 0.1 at limit) leading to incorrect/inadequate corrective force; cart accelerates to ~3.9 m/s while pole diverges with omega ~-5.7 rad/s. Removing noise alone restores stability, proving noise-induced feedback destabilization is the cause.
vision_note: Frames 14-16 show the blue cart drifting steadily rightward while the pole leans increasingly from upright with its tip orange. At frame 17 the tip turns red as the pole crosses the upright limit, while the cart continues its rightward motion without any external impact.
